title: Sorcerer With A Minigun (v28)
description: Wave-based arena RPG with destructible walls, minion summoning, minigun & railgun weapons, dash, vitality upgrades, and knockback.
prompt:
make the following changes:

1. add a vitality upgrade, this upgrade on level 1 adds 10hp*wave number, so wave 5 would be an extra 50hp. level 2 and level 3 are 20hp and 40hp, make these upgrades relativly expensive.

2. make q also dash so there are 2 different keys for dash q or space they both work

3. add knock back so when you get hit by an enemy you get knocked back a bit.
